scope: Every arity last input of the explicitly defined family only. No assumed abstract degree recurrence. Does not prove symmetry, remaining input degrees beyondm4, all-m geometric zero-sum equivalence, irreducibility, solving degree, attack complexity, signed standing or independent-host validation.
statement: The actual canonical Semaev resultant family is defined over independent polynomial coefficient rings, starting with the invariant-form S3 and taking actual fixed-size Sylvester-resultant successors. For every field and every aritym>=3 its last-input degree is2^(m-2). Each successor leading coefficient is the square of the preceding polynomial, and its arity4member equals the previously checked canonical S4.
